input.rationale: Register an initial source-grounded partial A1 map without asserting a violation or creating an obligation. The majority/startIndex protections are explicit, while producer truth is a separate gap. The next selected discriminator is pipeline future completion and error/request correlation: synchronous replication checks its transport error, whereas the decoder consumes Request/Response directly. Read actual AppendPipeline producers and interfaces before inferring any mismatch. This has a smaller evidentiary cost than a full membership or recovery history and can either close the asymmetry via transport guarantees or justify a scoped question. Snapshot and membership paths remain visible alternate producers/contexts; no execution Evidence or overall correctness conclusion is claimed.

result.summary: Submitted a schema-validated partial map of replication support and commitment. Identified quorum protections and unresolved producer guarantees. Next discriminator: pipeline completion, error handling, and request correlation. No violation or execution evidence claimed.

func (r *Raft) setupLeaderState() {
	r.leaderState.commitCh = make(chan struct{}, 1)
	r.leaderState.commitment = newCommitment(r.leaderState.commitCh,
		r.configurations.latest,
		r.getLastIndex()+1 /* first index that may be committed in this term */)
	r.leaderState.inflight = list.New()
	r.leaderState.replState = make(map[ServerID]*followerReplication)
	r.leaderState.notify = make(map[*verifyFuture]struct{})
	r.leaderState.stepDown = make(chan struct{}, 1)
}
